keepStressAtPauseInQuestions: When an āya ends in a question (e.g. أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ, أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ, أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ الْحَاكِمِينَ), keep the before-second-sukūn stress even at the pause (Rule 2 note). Detect via the interrogative hamza in the āya's last sentence, or list them manually.
